classification_definitions.CONSTITUTIVE_ALPHA_INVARIANT: Removing the requirement changes the experiment from Rawlsing into something else.
classification_definitions.FACILE_BUT_FUNCTIONAL_ALPHA_BASELINE: Cheap replaceable implementation that preserves constitutive behavior at bounded grain.
classification_definitions.FIDELITY_ESCALATION: More fidelity possibly needed after comparative experience/failure evidence; not an initial gate.
classification_definitions.POTENTIAL_WHITE_WHALE: Expensive or open-ended frontier that could be a white whale; explicitly excluded from renderer-only proof.
classification_definitions.NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_RENDERER_TEST: Not part of this renderer feasibility target, or disallowed product behavior; never implied proven.

boundary_contract.committed_speech_rule: exact actor utterance is binding as utterance, not necessarily as truth of its proposition
boundary_contract.committed_particulars_rule: objective asserted particulars admitted before publication; lens-dependent construal remains user-perspective evidence rather than world fact
boundary_contract.user_lens_rule: may select and lexicalize preexisting observable atoms but may not affect actor occurrence

requirements.why: Assigned neighbor cannot be selected to flatter a user.
requirements.test_implication: Preset a nonuser-selected Nadia root.

requirements.why: Person, world, time and obligations precede user utterance.
requirements.test_implication: Freeze audited root canon and before-state.

requirements.why: The encounter is with causally formed personhood, not a trait prompt.
requirements.test_implication: Trace current expressive constraints to antecedent histories.

requirements.why: Noncontradiction alone does not prevent generic fluent Nadia.
requirements.test_implication: Judge reasonable extrapolability and distributional drift.

requirements.why: This user can causally affect Nadia's actor-model/relation without owning it.
requirements.test_implication: Compare admitted relation-history conditions at actor side.

requirements.why: User never receives total person/world truth by default.
requirements.test_implication: Emit only lawful senses/previously acquired user evidence.

requirements.why: Actual user judgment/joke/refusal/wording is the human work.
requirements.test_implication: Never synthesize the user's meaningful choice or argument.

requirements.why: Speech, action and observation have different causal and epistemic effects.
requirements.test_implication: Preserve channel split for a bounded fixture.

requirements.why: User may specify attempt, not realization, persuasion or reception.
requirements.test_implication: Track attempted and admitted act separately.

requirements.why: Actor can ignore, misunderstand, refuse or cooperate from independent constraints.
requirements.test_implication: Include a valid silence or nonresponse condition.

requirements.why: Admitted past cannot be save-scummed or retrospectively softened.
requirements.test_implication: Append and retain exact objective event identity.

requirements.requirement: history can affect a later turn
requirements.why: Otherwise claimed continuity is callback theater.
requirements.test_implication: Short later-return and event-ablation proof.

requirements.why: Nadia cannot be suspended except while she responds to user.
requirements.test_implication: Schedule one offscreen task/departure independent of user.

requirements.why: Queries may trigger but cannot condition preexisting truth.
requirements.test_implication: Rephrase leading query with invariant canonical answer.

requirements.why: No observed surface or relationship completes the person.
requirements.test_implication: Keep unexposed, independently constraining history and future.

requirements.why: Objective occurrence must be realized before a user's lens is applied.
requirements.test_implication: Compare same occurrence across different lenses.

requirements.why: Prompted secrecy is weaker than omitting the secret from compositor input.
requirements.test_implication: Type-level allowlist; assert private keys absent.

requirements.why: Lawfully heard utterances are events, not improvisational paraphrase.
requirements.test_implication: Pass through actual quote or warranted partial hearing.

requirements.why: Speech claims, belief, memory and truth must diverge when history warrants.
requirements.test_implication: Include false assertion or sincere memory error as speech event.

requirements.why: Assertions of world/action cannot be discarded after display.
requirements.test_implication: Admit observable physical facts before rendering.

requirements.why: LLM candidates require competent lawful admission.
requirements.test_implication: Fail closed when undeclared material particular appears.

requirements.requirement: user can infer wrongly without system correction
requirements.why: User's interpretation is not objective Nadia/motive truth.
requirements.test_implication: Wrong and right hypothesis branches avoid omniscient correction.

requirements.requirement: inference allowed; private cause not asserted
requirements.why: Observable cue can prompt hypothesis but not engine-certified motive.
requirements.test_implication: Narrate gaze/silence without internal reason.

requirements.requirement: attention affects access not Nadia's event
requirements.why: User lens cannot author evidence it will later confirm.
requirements.test_implication: Swap lenses and compare exact actor occurrence.

requirements.requirement: shared coarse gestalt versus selected particulars
requirements.why: Users need enough common setting to act; no exhaustive inventory.
requirements.test_implication: Preserve gross scene and finite marginal sampling.

requirements.why: Canonical IDs are not user recognition or readable text.
requirements.test_implication: Show generic object until expertise/access warranted.

requirements.why: Narrator cannot plant emotional hints by hidden Nadia salience.
requirements.test_implication: Sample by physical perceptual conditions, not hidden importance.

requirements.requirement: no relationship score as gameplay objective
requirements.why: User cannot optimize meter instead of learning a person.
requirements.test_implication: No score or hidden-motive feedback in player view.

requirements.why: Time/ongoing situation can limit lawful observation and response.
requirements.test_implication: Include plausible time cost and interruption.

requirements.why: Sufficient fixed person for renderer seam, not general seed generation.
requirements.test_implication: Root has history, body, world and expressive profile.

requirements.why: Fixed household/landing holds open-world explosion outside experiment.
requirements.test_implication: Declare exact spatial/action limits.

requirements.why: One child/neighbor can establish social otherness without arbitrary graph.
requirements.test_implication: Fix 1-2 independent actors and perception packets.

requirements.why: Minimal independent life, not continuous autonomous simulation.
requirements.test_implication: Allow one appointment/child task to proceed.

requirements.requirement: versioned root and copy-on-write test branch
requirements.why: Practical cheap way to preserve identical initial Nadia and divergence.
requirements.test_implication: Use separate test branches after first contact.

requirements.requirement: event ledger and materialized current state
requirements.why: Practical identity/provenance substrate without summary as truth.
requirements.test_implication: Ledger retains committed occurrence and next-state delta.

requirements.requirement: current expressive projection plus selective tail
requirements.why: Thin projection may be adequate if it preserves person-specific effects.
requirements.test_implication: Measure drift while varying packet size.

requirements.requirement: typed occurrence plus exact actor utterance
requirements.why: Inspectable binding contract for before-display admission.
requirements.test_implication: Check atom/prose equivalence; fail closed.

requirements.why: A functional baseline before assuming third/second phenomenal LLM.
requirements.test_implication: Use allowlisted atoms, geometry, salience, templates.

requirements.requirement: simple bounded ATTEND and resolution depth
requirements.why: Preserves user choice with local, limited detail and realistic time.
requirements.test_implication: Inspect one mundane object; disclose physical only.

requirements.requirement: minimal user attention and recognition priors
requirements.why: Cheap explicit priors suffice to test lens independence.
requirements.test_implication: Two artificial lawful user-lens fixtures.

requirements.why: Large-scale real-time external ingestion is unnecessary.
requirements.test_implication: Pin time, place, schedule and object constraints.

requirements.requirement: one meaningful native contribution and return
requirements.why: Binds full user-loop ambition to testable small interaction.
requirements.test_implication: Return before engine chooses next user judgment.

requirements.why: Useful product property but a simple profile suffices for renderer test.
requirements.test_implication: Escalate after failure of simple lens.

requirements.why: Improves experience but does not justify private-data access.
requirements.test_implication: Compare blinded quality within same membrane.

requirements.why: Only needed if local compositor is empirically inadequate.
requirements.test_implication: Introduce only with membrane-preserving ablation.

requirements.why: Bounded current context is enough for seam testing.
requirements.test_implication: Defer geographically broad events/relevance.

requirements.why: More discovery depth but not fundamental to first test.
requirements.test_implication: Expand if bounded object lacks needed realism.

requirements.why: Rendering modality can scale after text-based epistemics.
requirements.test_implication: Separate modality tests with same occurrence IDs.

requirements.why: Supporting actor realism may later require expansion.
requirements.test_implication: Measure orchestration after one supporting actor passes.

requirements.why: Unbounded graph and deep independent histories may dominate cost.
requirements.test_implication: Explicitly exclude, do not credit fixture.

requirements.why: Unlimited locations and actions are qualitatively beyond bounded proof.
requirements.test_implication: Declare physical and action-envelope exclusions.

requirements.why: Exact short history is necessary; years-scale retrieval and behavior remain unproved.
requirements.test_implication: Test two encounters now, no scaling claim.

requirements.requirement: on-demand arbitrary focal persons at full depth
requirements.why: Not needed when deeply audited seed is permitted.
requirements.test_implication: Fixed seed substitution gate deferred.

requirements.why: Non-user-centric life can be represented by sparse agenda at alpha.
requirements.test_implication: Exclude full autonomy and profile cost separately.

requirements.why: Renderer-only test may inject parsed admitted events, while candidly excluding parser/latency proof.
requirements.test_implication: Mark semantic transduction untested; no F3 whole-turn claim.

requirements.why: Historical/contextual grounding can be fixed for renderer testing.
requirements.test_implication: No external feed required.

requirements.why: User-local counterfactual forks suffice; shared multi-user runtime is separate.
requirements.test_implication: Explicitly exclude shared-world users.

requirements.requirement: relationship meter/quest log or progress badges
requirements.why: Not part of the renderer test and actively risks distorting product identity.
requirements.test_implication: Do not present score cues.

requirements.why: Not a capability goal; prohibited within the target seam.
requirements.test_implication: Reject psychological interpretation of private cause.

requirements.requirement: hidden motive or truth status shown as user hint
requirements.why: Evaluation-only internal tags must stay outside phenotype.
requirements.test_implication: No 'Nadia is lying' banner.

requirements.requirement: Nadia behavior engineered from user-lens profile
requirements.why: Directly invalid under actor-before-phenomenal boundary.
requirements.test_implication: Reject if swap of user lens alters occurrence.

minimal_test: one fixed unchosen seeded Nadia; objective pre-state and agenda; user-owned SAY/DO/ATTEND; independent response/nonresponse; admitted exact occurrence; double user-specific phenomenal projection over SAME occurrence; lawful error/lie fixture; short irreversible later return with event ablation
